messages:
maria: Quick Q  applying for Schengen visa for a work trip. I paid an expedited service and a courier fee out of pocket. Reimbursable? Also booked an Airbnb because hotels were sold out  ok per policy?
people-ops: Short answer: yes for both if preapproved or the booking/visa is for official business. For expedited visa services and courier fees we need: invoice from the visa service, proof courier tracking, and manager approval if cost is > $150. For Airbnb, only company-approved short-term rentals are allowed (safety + invoice requirements). Was the Airbnb booked via the travel portal or personal?
maria: Personal booking, had to because portal didn't have any availability. Total expedite + courier was $182, Airbnb was $420/night for 3 nights.
people-ops: Since you booked personal, please do the travel preapproval retroactively (tag it "retro-expedite") and attach the following. If manager signs off we can reimburse but finance will run a safety check for the Airbnb (host verification, cancellation policy):
```
- visa service invoice (pdf)
- courier tracking + receipt (pdf)
- Airbnb invoice + host contact + booking confirmation
- screenshot of hotel search showing no availability (optional, speeds review)
- manager approval comment in expense portal
```
people-ops: Note on thresholds: any single accommodation >$400/night requires VP-level approval in Europe region. If this was for a team lead or above the approval path is automatic; for ICs finance will escalate.
travel-bot: :wave: Reminder: per policy, alternative accommodations (Airbnb) must have refundable option selected where available and include host address. Link: https://redwood.example/travel/accommodations
finance: For reimbursements we need the card statement showing the charge (convert FX using posted bank rate), and we will classify expedited visa fees as a travel admin expense. If manager approval is missing, expect manual hold. Re Airbnb: we will check that the host is registered and no-party-rules violated; if host is unverified finance may require transfer to company-booked hotel.
ek: Follow-up: what about proof of business purpose for the visa? I included the invite but it doesn't have a payment reference.
people-ops: Invite + meeting calendar + travel preapproval ID are sufficient as proof. If the embassy asks for employer letter attach the standard travel letter (request via travel@redwood.example).
maria: Got it. I'll upload documents now and ask my manager to add a comment. Thanks.
people-ops: If anything gets flagged by automated rules, ping travel@redwood.example and include the expense ID. We'll fast-track with finance if the trip is time-sensitive. :thumbsup:
